story.title: Canada Retaliates with Tariffs Amid Escalating Trade Tensions with the US
story.summary: Canada has announced new tariffs on nearly $20 billion worth of US products, with rates reaching as high as 50%. This move is a response to ongoing trade tensions, with officials warning that the US trade war 'will come at a cost.'

timeline_highlights.summary: Canada has announced retaliatory tariffs on approximately $20 billion worth of American goods, including steel, dairy products, appliances, and farm equipment. The tariffs could lead to increased costs for American businesses and further strain diplomatic ties.

revisions.title: Trump Signs Executive Order to Rename Lake Ontario Amid Trade Dispute with Canada
revisions.summary: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' in the United States. This move is part of escalating tensions in a trade dispute with Canada. The order directs federal agencies to implement the name change on US maps and documents, although it does not affect the Canadian portion of the lake, which Canada has rejected.

related_stories.title: Trump Issues Threat Against Bombardier's US Sales Amid Trade Tensions
related_stories.summary: Donald Trump has threatened to prevent Canadian aircraft manufacturer Bombardier from selling its planes in the United States unless the company relocates its manufacturing operations to the US. This warning comes as trade tensions escalate between the two countries, particularly in light of Canada's tariffs on US imports, which can reach up to 50%. Previously, Trump had also expressed intentions to decertify Bombardier aircraft due to certification disputes regarding US-made planes.

related_stories.title: Eiffel Tower Reopens After Staff Walkout Over Hindu Group's Request to Limit Women
related_stories.summary: The Eiffel Tower reopened on Tuesday following a staff walkout in protest of management instructions that limited the presence of women during a visit by a Hindu religious group. The Bochasanwasi Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Sanstha (BAPS) later apologized for any inconvenience caused. The operating company acknowledged that the conditions requested by the delegation should not have been accepted.
